LLMS.TXT Configuration
Enable LLMS.TXT Generation
Enable automatic generation of llms.txt file for this site
Site Title Override
Override the homepage title for llms.txt. Leave empty to use the page title.
e.g., University of Worms - Study Programs & Research
Site Description Override
Override the homepage description for llms.txt. Leave empty to use the page description.
Additional Information (Markdown)
Add custom content to llms.txt in Markdown format. This will be appended after the navigation structure. Use this for special instructions, policies, or additional context for LLMs.
Contact Email
Contact email for inquiries about the site content
Keywords/Topics
Comma-separated keywords or topics that describe your site (e.g., "higher education, computer science, business administration")
higher education, research, international programs
Navigation Depth
Maximum depth of page hierarchy to include in navigation (1-5 levels)
AI Search Assistant
Enable AI Search Assistant
Show the floating chat assistant on this site (requires the global assistant switch in the extension configuration).
Assistant Title
Heading shown in the assistant window. Leave empty for the default.
Welcome Message
First message the assistant shows when the window is opened.
Input Placeholder
Placeholder text shown in the question input field.
Logo / Photo

Optional image shown as a round avatar in the assistant (header, floating button and next to answers). Enter a path or URL: e.g. "fileadmin/logo.png", "EXT:my_ext/Resources/Public/Images/bot.png" or "https://example.com/logo.png".
AI Assistant Colors
Accent Color
Accent color for the toggle button, send button and focus highlights (hex, e.g. #2563eb). Leave empty for the default.
Background Color
Background color of the chat window and input (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Text Color
Text color for the frame, header, close button and general UI text (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Background Color User Message
Background color of the visitor's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Text Color User Message
Text color of the visitor's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Link Color User Message
Link color inside the visitor's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Background Color Assistant Message
Background color of the assistant's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Text Color Assistant Message
Text color of the assistant's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Link Color Assistant Message
Link color inside the assistant's message bubbles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Background Color Sources
Background color of the source result cards (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Text Color Sources
Text color of the source snippets (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Link Color Sources
Link color of the source titles (hex). Leave empty for the default.
Custom CSS File

Optional path or URL to your own CSS file, loaded after the widget's default styles so your rules win. E.g. "fileadmin/assistant.css", "EXT:my_ext/Resources/Public/Css/assistant.css" or "https://example.com/assistant.css". Scope selectors under #wn-ai-assistant.
Open Automatically
Automatically open the assistant overlay after a delay when a visitor lands on a page. It will not reopen after the visitor closes it during the same visit.
Auto-Open Delay (seconds)
Number of seconds to wait before the overlay opens automatically (0 = immediately).
Additional Instructions
Extra instructions for the assistant (persona, tone, what to recommend). Appended to the base system prompt. Only used when an LLM API key is configured.
OnePager Mode

Enable if this site is a OnePager (sub-pages are rendered as sections on the homepage). Result links to direct children of the site root then use anchors (e.g. "/#customers") instead of separate sub-page URLs.
Learn from visitor corrections
Optional value for this language. Leave empty to use the site-level value (and finally the bundled translation).
Optional value for this language. Leave empty to use the site-level (default language) value.

When enabled, a correction a visitor makes to an answer is captured for review in the "Answers" backend module. Only corrections you approve are used in future answers (and only when a question thematically matches). Off by default.
Search Root Page
Optional page id to restrict the search to a subtree. 0 = search the whole site.

Subscription key: The licence key issued to you. It is encrypted and signed and carries the domains it is valid for and an expiry date. Without a valid key the chat widget and the backend modules "Enquiries" and "Answers" stay switched off
Verification key (optional): Only fill this in when the issuer has rolled over its key pair. Leave empty to use the key bundled with the extension

Daily status check: Asks the issuing server once a day whether the subscription is still active, so a revocation takes effect immediately. The check runs in the backend and on the command line, never inside a visitor request. When the server cannot be reached, the key stays valid until its expiry date
Issuing server (optional): Base URL for the status check. Leave empty to use the address carried inside the key
HTML parsing fallback: Convert the rendered HTML of a page when no structured content could be read
Debug: Returns internal error details on the .md endpoint and writes rendered HTML to var/log. For local troubleshooting only — keep this off in production
Cache Markdown: Keeps the generated Markdown of a page in the TYPO3 cache
Log bot access: Records requests by bots and crawlers to llms.txt, the Markdown versions (.md) and regular pages. Shown in the backend module "Bot Access Log" (mind data protection)
Enable rate limiter: Throttles AI Bridge requests (llms.txt / .md) globally
Requests per minute per IP: Maximum number of AI Bridge requests per minute and client IP (0 = unlimited)
Requests per minute per API key / bot id: Maximum number of AI Bridge requests per minute and API key or bot id (0 = unlimited)
Enable AI search assistant: Master switch for the chat widget that helps visitors find information on the site
LLM provider: Provider used to compose answers. Without an API key the assistant answers from search results alone
LLM API key: API key of the provider. Leave empty for search-only mode (hits and links without a composed answer)
LLM model: Model id used to compose answers, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5 for fast and inexpensive answers or claude-sonnet-5 for harder questions
Search sources: Which search indexes are used (Automatic uses everything available)
Maximum search hits: How many hits are used as context and offered as suggestions
Answer token limit: Upper bound for the length of one answer. This is the main lever on the cost per answer

Temperature: How much the answer may vary, as a decimal between 0.0 (precise, deterministic) and 1.0 (creative). Keep this low — the assistant should reproduce what is on the site, not invent variations. Example: 0.2
Agent instructions: Global instructions for the model (persona, tone, rules) applied to every answer. Valid for all sites; each site can add to them in its site configuration
Bot protection: Blocks requests to the assistant that do not come from a human visitor using the widget (crawlers, scripts, known bots). A deterrent, not authentication
Log questions and answers: Stores every question and answer with date, IP address, provider and token usage. Shown in the backend module "Enquiries" (mind data protection)

Country lookup in the log module: Resolves the country of an IP address through an external service (ip-api.com) while the log is displayed. Results are cached. Off by default for data protection reasons
USD to CHF rate: Conversion rate for the estimated LLM cost shown in the log module (model prices are quoted in USD). Example: 0.90
